scope: Corollary 1.2 (Unshifted rank and exact lifts) of the manuscript “Exponential PSD rank of positively shifted matching matrices” (preprints/Exponential-PSD-rank-of-positively-shifted-matching-matrices-October-5-2026/shifted-matching-psd.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 126 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7e90c5f1e508114d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are constants c0 > 0 and n1 such that, for every even n ≥ n1, both An(0) and Tn(0) have real PSD rank at least 2c0n, and every exact semidefinite lift of Pn has size at least 2c0n.
